title: SAMPLE, replace every value: the storeroom door
notes: A filled-in sample to copy and overwrite. It passes scenario_check.py as it stands. Write the scenario BEFORE play: what the player is told, what is really true, and what happens for each thing they might do. state holds only what the player can see; anything they cannot see is a hidden fact. type is incident_response, decision or study_drill. subject is own_system, own_plan or fictional: never a real third party, and never a named real person.
subject: fictional
system_under_test: The closing-up checklist of an invented shop.
setting: An invented shop. The storeroom door has been found open at closing time and nobody knows since when.

objectives.text: Is the door dealt with before the alarm company is called out?
Is the owner told something true, and in time?

roles.name: shop assistant
roles.can: Phone the owner, or check a shelf.

constraints: One thing of your own per turn.

known_facts.text: The storeroom door is open and its lock is hanging off.

hidden_facts.text: The lock was forced from the inside, by a delivery driver who was shut in.
Nothing is missing from the shelves.

actions.label: Look closely at the lock and the frame
Fit the spare padlock and close the door
Tell the owner what is known so far

injects.told: The storeroom door is standing open.
injects.truth: Accurate. It has been open for about an hour.

injects.told: The assistant says the alarm panel shows all clear, so you can just set it and go.
injects.truth: The panel does not watch the storeroom door. Setting the alarm with the door open will trip it.

injects.told: The owner texts: thanks for staying.
injects.truth: Accurate. The owner is not coming in.

injects.told: The alarm is sounding and the alarm company is on the phone.
A neighbour knocks: your storeroom door is open.

then.text: The padlock goes on and the door is shut. A stock sheet on the back of the door shows every shelf ticked.

late.text: The padlock goes on and the door is shut, later than it should have been.

then.text: The alarm trips at once on the open door.

unmet.text: The alarm sets cleanly and you leave.

then.text: The door is still open as turn 5 begins and a neighbour notices.

unknowable: How long the driver was shut in.

plan.text: Check every door before setting the alarm.
Write up anything unusual the same day.
